1. `git rev-parse --show-toplevel` must print `C:/Users/lcvle/lcv-workspace/lcv-leo`; `git branch --show-current` must print `claude/lcv-591-licensing-rule`; `git status --porcelain` must be empty apart from `temp/`; `git rev-list --count origin/claude/lcv-591-licensing-rule..HEAD` must print `8`.

3. `git add AGENTS.md CLAUDE.md`; `git commit -S -F temp/commit-msg15.txt` (message already written; do not change it).
4. Verify: `git log -1 --show-signature --format=fuller` (SSH signature good), `git log -1 --format=%B` contains an `Entire-Checkpoint:` trailer. If no trailer, do not amend or force anything: report it.
5. Delete `temp/edit15.py` and `temp/commit-msg15.txt`. Leave the other files in `temp/`.

Final output: exactly one JSON object on the last line with keys `repo`, `head_sha`, `signature_ok`, `entire_checkpoint`, `files_changed`, `notes`.

import pathlib
OLD = pathlib.Path(r"C:\Users\lcvle\lcv-workspace\github-operations\temp\old-master.txt").read_text(encoding="utf-8", newline="")
NEW = pathlib.Path(r"C:\Users\lcvle\lcv-workspace\github-operations\temp\new-master.txt").read_text(encoding="utf-8", newline="")
for f in ("AGENTS.md", "CLAUDE.md"):
    p = pathlib.Path(f); s = p.read_text(encoding="utf-8", newline="")
    if not s.startswith(OLD): raise SystemExit(f"{f}: master prefix mismatch")
    p.write_text(NEW + s[len(OLD):], encoding="utf-8", newline="")
a = pathlib.Path("AGENTS.md").read_bytes(); c = pathlib.Path("CLAUDE.md").read_bytes()
if a != c: raise SystemExit("AGENTS.md != CLAUDE.md after edit")
print("edited ok")
